Choices.name: dsp_decision
Choices.requiredMessage: A decision for this candidate is required

Choice.hint: Correct fault type clearly heard, DSP interval is correct, no edits needed
Real fault, but boundaries were adjusted / intervals deleted or added
Not a fault, wrong type, or corrupted file → keep the previous fault_status
Still unsure after listening twice → send to a second reviewer (maps to pending in the DB)
Sample is not a DSP candidate (used only when auditing regex/LLM sources)

Choices.name: reason
Choices.requiredMessage: A reason code is required when rejecting or marking unsure

Choice.hint: No fault of the candidate's type is audible
A real fault exists but of a different type → write the actual type in the note
Natural speech characteristic misread by DSP as a fault (breath pause, fricatives, breathing)
Corrupted, truncated, or unplayable file, or length does not match duration
Fault is certainly present but no reliable boundary can be set → explain in the note
Cannot decide whether a fault exists
DSP and LLM/regex disagree and there is no basis to pick one
